items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (cracked rib) practiced Friday, improved steadily; team did not elevate WR and optimism he plays vs Raiders (flak jacket expected).
items.why: Steady improvement; no WR elevation signals confidence.
items.implication: If active, full-ish role likely; if out, QJ/Harris volume spike.

items.text: Saints WR Chris Olave (hamstring), listed questionable, is expected to play at Baltimore.
items.why: Traveled and expected per sources; Chase Young also expected.
items.implication: Maintains WR1 role; no major beneficiary shift.
items.opportunity: Full target share if active as expected.

items.text: Raiders elevated TE Chris Myarick with Brock Bowers doubtful (knee/meniscus); pregame workout possible but unlikely.
items.why: Meniscus trim recovery; limited/returned Friday practice but doubtful designation.
items.implication: Michael Mayer steps up as TE1; Jeanty usage elevated in absence.
items.opportunity: Mayer targets/routes; Jeanty receiving work continues.

items.text: Ravens downgraded WR Zay Flowers to OUT for Sunday vs. Saints due to hamstring injury.
items.implication: Removes top Ravens WR; opens targets for Likely/Andrews/others.
items.opportunity: Increased target share for remaining pass-catchers.

items.text: Rams consider WR Puka Nacua (hip/groin), questionable for MNF vs Giants, a pre-game decision; Whittington doubtful (quad).
items.why: Missed second straight practice; different from camp psoas.
items.implication: Have pivot ready; if out heavier TE usage + Mumpfield/Fields.

items.text: Broncos RB R.J. Harvey (hamstring), questionable, is unlikely to play vs Jaguars.
items.why: Source indicates unlikely despite Q tag.

items.text: Bengals elevated QB Josh Johnson with Joe Burrow questionable (back) but expected to play vs Texans.
items.why: Elevation is precaution; Burrow trending to play.
items.implication: Full offense if active; Chase/Higgins volume intact.

items.text: Steelers downgraded WR Michael Pittman Jr. to OUT for Sunday vs Patriots with foot injury.
items.implication: DK Metcalf primary; Wilson/Bernard up in rotation.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins (hamstring) ruled OUT for Sunday vs Bengals.
items.opportunity: TE1 bump for Schultz; WR volume redistribution.

items.text: ETR Cheap WR Volume: Quentin Johnston and Tre Harris project 5+ targets; large roles if McConkey out vs Raiders (friendly matchup). Johnston above 5 even if McConkey plays.
items.why: Week 1 target shares post-McConkey exit (22%+); contingency planning.
items.implication: DFS/season-long volume plays if status changes.
items.opportunity: 5+ target floor projections; role expansion on absence.

items.text: 49ers RB Kaelon Black (groin), questionable, is expected to play vs Dolphins; Shanahan called minor.
items.why: Limited but expected; minor per coach.
items.implication: Maintains RB role share in favorable matchup.

items.text: Berry LOVES Kenneth Walker vs IND: 74% snaps, 21/24 RB touches through 3Q, 40% route targets (team lead); Indy gave up 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry.
Berry LOVES Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: 99 utilization (tied Bijan), 19% target share last 10, 25+ touches in 3/4 recent.
items.why: Near-max utilization and receiving work; soft Chargers front.
items.implication: RB1/2 with receiving upside, especially if Bowers out.

items.text: Berry LOVES Bucky Irving vs CLE: RB9 util, 26% target share, 100% RB RZ touches; CLE allowed 121 rush/4.8 YPC.
Berry HATES Travis Etienne @ BAL: matched Kendre Miller rushes W1, most points via air; Kamara expected back squeezes role further as underdogs.
items.why: Committee risk with Kamara return + negative script.
items.conflict: Prior volume assumptions stale with Kamara.

items.text: Berry LOVES Justin Jefferson @ CHI: 37% target share from Wentz W1; 93 yds/18 PPG career with Wentz; CHI soft vs WRs.
Berry LOVES Dak Prescott vs WAS: home smash, WAS torched 14.5 YPC/3 TDs W1; top-5 implied total in high-total game.
Berry HATES Marvin Harrison Jr. vs SEA: only 8% target share W1 (5th on team), zero RZ; SEA tough vs WRs.
